chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from the one who informed him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one in Ihram cannot immerse himself into the water.

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: the person in the state of Ihram (ritual consecration for Hajj/Umrah)
key_terms.يَرْتَمِسُ: to immerse oneself fully in water

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on immersing in water while in the state of Ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies that a pilgrim in the state of Ihram is prohibited from fully immersing their body in water, a ruling derived from the general prohibition of removing clothing and covering the head. Scholars note this restriction emphasizes maintaining the simplicity and uniformity of the pilgrim's state, distinguishing Ihram rituals from ordinary daily activities.
